title: When the World Shuts Down But God's Spirit Opens Up
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a personal story of faith and perseverance as he and his wife stood on God's promises despite facing financial struggles and uncertainty during the COVID-19 pandemic. You'll be encouraged to trust in God's provision and sovereignty, even when it feels like everything is against you. Join Pastor Chris as he reveals the lessons he learned about standing on God's word and relying on His goodness, rather than human solutions.
